'''D-series protocol droids''' were a model of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[T'Chttrk]] used her D-series protocol droid [[D-P4M]] as an interpreter.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
